transcript.text:
Hi everyone! The family wants to use my late grandfather's 35mm camera for a portrait session, which I'm happy to make the final call on. We're looking at a Saturday or Sunday in mid-May 2027, and we can do it either in my living room or out at the nearby park. I've got two unopened rolls of film ready to go, plus an external flash and a handheld light meter since the camera doesn't have a built-in flash.

Before I confirm any details, I'd like to follow my usual routine: Jordan, could you let me know your availability for those mid-May weekends and any practical considerations? Then Leah, same for you — availability and any practical or outside-expert info you can share. Once I've heard from both of you, I'll make the final decision on the details.
